missions.title: Hello Village
missions.topic: Meet your friends · names and age
missions.subtitle: Meet the villagers
missions.guide: Tap a word block. Say hello to a new friend!
missions.reminder: Use the words in the story. Tap Listen to hear them.

tasks.prompt: Hello! My name ___ Hana.
tasks.hint: Say: My name is Hana.
tasks.explain: My name is Hana. We use is after My name.

tasks.prompt: I ___ seven.
tasks.hint: Say: I am seven.
tasks.explain: I am seven. Am goes with I.

tasks.prompt: A boy is called Dan. ___ name is Dan.
tasks.hint: Dan is a boy. Say: His name is Dan.
tasks.explain: His tells us the name of the boy.

tasks.prompt: A girl is called May. ___ name is May.
tasks.hint: May is a girl. Say: Her name is May.
tasks.explain: Her tells us the name of the girl.

tasks.prompt: Ben is six. How ___ is Ben?
tasks.hint: Ask How old? to find out an age.
tasks.explain: How old is Ben? The answer is six.

missions.title: Toy Bridge
missions.subtitle: Help friends find their toys
missions.guide: Tap a word block to add a bridge block. Return each toy to its owner!
missions.reminder: His tells us about a boy. Her tells us about a girl.

tasks.prompt: This ball belongs to Dan. It is ___ ball.
tasks.hint: Dan is a boy. His ball belongs to Dan.
tasks.explain: His ball is the ball that belongs to Dan.

tasks.prompt: This doll belongs to May. It is ___ doll.
tasks.hint: May is a girl. Her doll belongs to May.
tasks.explain: Her doll is the doll that belongs to May.

tasks.prompt: Ben is a boy. ___ is six.
tasks.hint: Ben is a boy. Use He.
tasks.explain: He takes the place of Ben.

tasks.prompt: Hana is a girl. ___ is seven.
tasks.hint: Hana is a girl. Use She.
tasks.explain: She takes the place of Hana.

tasks.prompt: May has a kite. ___ favourite toy is her kite.
tasks.full: Her favourite toy is her kite.
tasks.hint: The kite belongs to May. Use Her.
tasks.explain: Her favourite toy is her kite. We are talking about May.

missions.title: Toy Train
missions.subtitle: Give the toys a label
missions.guide: Tap the word carriages in order. Build a toy label to move the train!
missions.reminder: Use a before red or big. Use an before orange or old.

tasks.prompt: Make a label for a red ball. Start with It.
tasks.hint: Start with It is. Add a red ball.
tasks.explain: A red ball. A comes before the word red.

tasks.prompt: Make a label for an orange kite. Start with It.
tasks.hint: Start with It is. Add an orange kite.
tasks.explain: An orange kite. An comes before orange.

tasks.prompt: Make a label for a big train. Start with It.
tasks.hint: Start with It is. Add a big train.
tasks.explain: A big train. A comes before big.

tasks.prompt: Make a label for an old car. Start with It.
tasks.hint: Start with It is. Add an old car.
tasks.explain: An old car. An comes before old.

tasks.prompt: Make a label for a new doll. Start with It.
tasks.hint: Start with It is. Add a new doll.
tasks.explain: A new doll. A comes before new.

missions.title: Classroom River
missions.subtitle: Help your class get ready
missions.guide: Put the word blocks in order. Each helpful instruction launches a boat!
missions.reminder: A helpful instruction can end with please.

tasks.prompt: Ask your friend to open a book. Start with Open.
tasks.hint: Start with Open. Add your book, then please.
tasks.explain: Open your book, please. This is a helpful classroom instruction.

tasks.prompt: Ask your friend to close a bag. Start with Close.
tasks.hint: Start with Close. Add your bag, then please.
tasks.explain: Close your bag, please. Close tells your friend what to do.

tasks.prompt: Ask for a pencil. Start with Pass.
tasks.hint: Start with Pass me. Add a pencil, then please.
tasks.explain: Pass me a pencil, please. Please makes your request polite.

tasks.prompt: Ask your friend to sit down. Start with Sit.
tasks.hint: Start with Sit. Then add down, and please.
tasks.explain: Sit down, please. This tells your friend what to do.

tasks.prompt: Ask your friend to look at a kite. Start with Look.
tasks.hint: Start with Look at. Add the kite, then please.
tasks.explain: Look at the kite, please. Look at tells your friend where to look.

missions.title: Pet Mine
missions.topic: I like · I do not like
missions.subtitle: Find a gem for each pet
missions.guide: Tap the word block that matches the story. Collect a pet gem!
missions.reminder: Like tells us what you enjoy. Do not like tells us what you do not enjoy.

tasks.prompt: Hana likes cats. She says: I ___ cats.
tasks.hint: Hana likes cats. Choose like.
tasks.explain: I like cats means Hana enjoys cats.

tasks.prompt: Dan does not like snakes. He says: I ___ snakes.
tasks.hint: Dan does not like snakes. Choose do not like.
tasks.explain: I do not like snakes tells us how Dan feels.

tasks.prompt: May likes ducks. She says: I ___ ducks.
tasks.hint: May likes ducks. Choose like.
tasks.explain: I like ducks means May enjoys ducks.

tasks.prompt: Ben does not like rats. He says: I ___ rats.
tasks.hint: Ben does not like rats. Choose do not like.
tasks.explain: I do not like rats tells us how Ben feels.

tasks.prompt: You enjoy dogs. Choose your words: I ___ dogs.
tasks.hint: You enjoy dogs. Say: I like dogs.
tasks.explain: I like dogs tells people what you enjoy.

missions.title: Lunchbox Portal
missions.subtitle: Pack lunch for the journey
missions.guide: Tap a word portal. Choose the words that match each lunchbox!
missions.reminder: Have got tells us what is in a lunchbox. Have not got tells us what is missing.

tasks.prompt: An apple is in my lunchbox. I ___ an apple.
tasks.hint: The apple is in the lunchbox. Say have got.
tasks.explain: I have got an apple means I have an apple.

tasks.prompt: There is no banana in my lunchbox. I ___ a banana.
tasks.full: I have not got a banana.
tasks.hint: The banana is missing. Say have not got.
tasks.explain: I have not got a banana means I do not have a banana.

tasks.prompt: We have some cheese. Have we got any cheese? Yes, we ___.
tasks.hint: The cheese is here. Say Yes, we have.
tasks.explain: Yes, we have answers the question about the cheese.

tasks.prompt: We have no cake. Have we got any cake? No, we ___.
tasks.hint: There is no cake. Say No, we have not.
tasks.explain: No, we have not means we do not have cake.

tasks.prompt: A sandwich is in my lunchbox. I have ___ a sandwich.
tasks.hint: Use the words have got together.
tasks.explain: I have got a sandwich tells us what is in the lunchbox.

missions.title: Pet Hideout
missions.subtitle: Find the hidden pets
missions.guide: Read the clue. Tap a place word to help a pet get home!
missions.reminder: In means inside. On means on top. Under means below.

tasks.prompt: The cat is inside the box. The cat is ___ the box.
tasks.full: The cat is in the box.
tasks.hint: Inside means in.
tasks.explain: In the box means inside the box.

tasks.prompt: The dog is on top of the bag. The dog is ___ the bag.
tasks.full: The dog is on the bag.
tasks.hint: On top means on.
tasks.explain: On the bag means on top of the bag.

tasks.prompt: The frog is below the desk. The frog is ___ the desk.
tasks.full: The frog is under the desk.
tasks.hint: Below means under.
tasks.explain: Under the desk means below the desk.

tasks.prompt: The rat is inside the bag. The rat is ___ the bag.
tasks.full: The rat is in the bag.
tasks.hint: Inside means in.
tasks.explain: In the bag means inside the bag.

tasks.prompt: The cat is below the chair. The cat is ___ the chair.
tasks.full: The cat is under the chair.
tasks.hint: Below means under.
tasks.explain: Under the chair means below the chair.

missions.title: Toy Castle
missions.subtitle: Choose the right size
missions.guide: Look at the sizes. Tap the object that matches the words!
missions.reminder: Look at both objects. Big and small tell us about size. Tall and short tell us about height.

tasks.prompt: Find the big chest.
tasks.hint: Look for the chest that takes up more space.
tasks.explain: Chest B is big. Chest A is small.

tasks.prompt: Find the small chest.
tasks.hint: Look for the chest that takes up less space.
tasks.explain: Chest A is small. Chest B is big.

tasks.prompt: Find the tall tower.
tasks.hint: Look for the tower that goes high up.
tasks.explain: Tower B is tall. Tower A is short.

tasks.prompt: Find the short tower.
tasks.hint: Look for the tower that does not go very high.
tasks.explain: Tower B is short. Tower A is tall.

tasks.prompt: Choose a big chest for the toys.
tasks.hint: Find the chest with more space for the toys.
tasks.explain: Chest A is big. It has more space for toys.

rules: shop
Meet your friends
My name is ... · I am seven.
Use these words to tell a friend your name and age.
My name is Hana. I am seven.
bridge
His and her
His = a boy's · Her = a girl's
Use his or her to talk about a name or a favourite toy.
Her kite belongs to May. His ball belongs to Dan.
train
Toy labels
a red ball · an orange kite
Use a before red. Use an before orange. Listen to the first sound of the next word.
It is an old car. It is a new doll.
boat
Helpful instructions
Open ... · Close ... · Pass me ...
Tell a friend what to do. Add please to be polite.
Close your bag, please.
pickaxe
What I like
I like ... · I do not like ...
Use these words to say what you enjoy.
I like cats. I do not like snakes.
portal
My lunchbox
I have got ... · I have not got ...
Have got tells us what you have. Have not got tells us what is missing.
I have got an apple. I have not got a banana.
cat
Where is the pet?
in = inside · on = on top · under = below
Use a place word to find the pet.
The cat is under the chair.
castle
Sizes
big · small · tall · short
Big and small tell us about size. Tall and short tell us about height.
The chest is big. The tower is tall.

curriculum.title: DSKP Bahasa Inggeris Tahun 1 — Primary Year 1 English Language Syllabus
learningStandards: 3.2.2: Read details in very simple phrases and sentences.
4.2.1: Give a name or age through familiar fixed phrases.
curriculum.note: Original medium-challenge practice using the SK Year 1 syllabus language in playful contexts. Year 1 grammar is experienced through meaning, fixed phrases and enjoyment, with short choices, word blocks, audio and hints. This pack practises selected language; game points do not determine a DSKP performance level.
